label: Angled Vent Cuff
description: The angled vent cuff is cut with a slight diagonal slant — typically dropping at the outer edge — so that when the arm hangs naturally, the cuff line follows the pitch of the wrist rather than sitting perfectly horizontal. This tailoring detail is common in English and Italian bespoke houses and serves both an aesthetic and ergonomic function: it allows a cleaner drape of the sleeve at the arm's natural angle and often better reveals a shirt cuff when the elbow is slightly bent. The result is a more animated, dynamic end to the sleeve compared to the static formality of a square cut.
